subject: mathematics
content: Let $A=\left[\begin{array}{ccc}\cos \theta & 0 & -\sin \theta \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ \sin \theta & 0 & \cos \theta\end{array}\right]$. If for some $\theta \in(0, \pi), A^2=A^T$, then the sum of the diagonal elements of the matrix $(\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{I})^3+(\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{I})^3-6 \mathrm{~A}$ is equal to _________ .
